title: Google OAuth client secret: one-property twin (length)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: a 27-byte body vs exactly 28 and length: a 29-byte body vs exactly 28. Twin of "Google OAuth client secret: must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of google-oauth-client-secret-dotenv: length: a 27-byte body vs exactly 28. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
